messages:
Lena K: heads up — opened PR with migration guide + a sensitive example that needs redaction before merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2193
Tom H: thanks lena. linking CI preview now, fails on docs-lint: https://ci.internal/redwood/2193/preview 
Priya S: can you point to which section has the sensitive example? I can redact and push a smaller patch.
Lena K: near 'data-exfiltration.md' paragraph 3 — we included a real customer sample accidentally. should switch to synthetic snippet.
Ezra M: @Priya S if you send the synthetic snippet I'll do a quick pass for security concerns. we also need legal + security ok for the final wording.
Priya S: pushing redaction patch in a sec — will replace with a synthetic request/response and a short note about redaction.
LegalBot: NOTE: Any customer-identifying examples need explicit Legal approval and an audit entry. File: docs/security/data-exfiltration.md flagged.
Tom H: re: CI — docs preview will re-run once PR updates. ETA ~10m after the push. please add `<!-- redacted: audit-id=TODO -->` comment so we can track.
Lena K: adding the comment now and tagging legal in the PR description. also cc @Security (Ezra M) for quick review.
Priya S: pushed commit 7f3a1b2 with synthetic snippet and the audit comment. preview link: https://ci.internal/redwood/2193/preview/7f3a1b2 — lint fixed but there is a broken internal link in the migration notes.
Tom H: I can take the link fix. looks like relative path should be ../guides/migration.md not ../migration-guide.md
Ezra M: quick read: synthetic snippet looks fine but keep the example outcome deterministic (use placeholders like <ORG>). Approve from security side once placeholders in place.
Lena K: updated placeholders to <ORG> and <EMAIL> per Ezra. added legal note in PR description: "Legal review requested — contains redacted example, audit comment present."
LegalBot: Legal review requested by @Lena K. Please allow 24-48 hours for full clearance; if urgent, provide business justification.
Priya S: pinging product: this doc change is blocking a small migration change in the SDK release. requested expedited review in PR.
Tom H: from release ops — if legal needs more time we can hold merge and cut a docs-only patch post-release. want to avoid holding the entire SDK release.
Ezra M: ack. I can do a provisional security thumbs-up for the redaction now — but final legal stamp required before public merge.
Lena K: understood. can we set a merge-hold label and add a follow-up issue for the audit ID once legal completes?
Tom H: yes — add label `merge-hold: legal` and set milestone to next docs sprint. I'll also set the GitHub branch protection to require the `legal/approved` check.
Priya S: thanks all. noted timeline: push redaction — done. security provisional OK — done. legal requested — done. CI preview green except for a minor anchor fix — done. next action: legal signoff or merge-hold.
LegalBot: Reminder: add contact for legal follow-up inside PR (name + emails).
Lena K: added Legal contact: priya@redwood.ai and product owner: lena@redwood.ai in PR body.
deploy-bot: deploy preview rebuilt for PR 2193 at 1977777835 — status: preview available.
Tom H: moving to deferred merge if no legal in 48h. tagging @release-team for visibility. :eyes: 
Lena K: thanks everyone — I'll monitor legal and update this thread with status. :pray:
